# 🌙 Overnight Idea

> **Overnight idea:** Introducing a periodic consolidation step—summarizing and compressing accumulated context as described in the consolidation paper—into the rewrite operation should further reduce cross‑fact interference, yielding higher downstream task scores than both plain rewrite and naive append in the required ablation study.
